verdicts.reason: A reads in a sensible order (badge, large headline, subcopy, phone, big CTA) and keeps a strong hierarchy, but the left-aligned text block and centred phone/CTA sit on different axes, the left margin is tight, and a stray cream circle fragment is clipped in the bottom-left corner. B lets the phone dominate and shrinks the headline into a cramped lower block. Its CTA is small and weak, the 'Online Only' badge has drifted to the bottom, cut off from the headline it belongs with, and the same clipped circle fragment shows in the corner.
